method.carrier_repair: One shared grammar-carrier predicate now drives both grammar-block and definition-carrier-line evidence. It accepts quoted and unquoted class attributes for prod, grammar, and railroad class tokens without weakening the pre/table/div/dl opening-tag boundary.
method.inventory_limit: The v2 heuristic arrays plus this repaired grammar-carrier delta are inclusive discovery evidence only. They prove no absence, normativity, ownership, or operation completeness.
method.mandatory_next_pass: The next occurrence-owner/fixed-point pass MUST read the full pinned source bytes, including parser algorithms, token/component-value behavior, recovery, and serialization beyond heuristic arrays. method.caveat: V3 grants no terminal exclusion, source inclusion, operation denominator, parser, conformance, movement, package, release, or production credit.
